values.stCk7: Ductular reaction and periportal hepatocyte expression

report:
Liver, random, biopsy

Sections show a core of liver measuring 18 mm in length, with 11 portal tracts. The portal tracts contain a moderate lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate with mild interface hepatitis. There is mild lobular inflammation. There are florid duct lesions and a ductular reaction. Bile ducts are absent from 3 of 11 portal tracts. Nakanuma scores: fibrosis 1, bile duct loss 1 and orcein-positive granules 1. Reticulin stain shows periportal or incomplete septal fibrosis. Orcein stain shows copper-associated protein in periportal hepatocytes. CK7 highlights a ductular reaction and is expressed by periportal hepatocytes.

LIVER, random, biopsy - CHRONIC NON-SUPPURATIVE DESTRUCTIVE CHOLANGITIS with PERIPORTAL FIBROSIS (Nakanuma stage 2, mild progression; CA2, HA1), consistent with PRIMARY BILIARY CHOLANGITIS
